channel.title: BridgePoint Automatic Research Briefs
channel.description: Quality-gated BridgePoint Intelligence research and market-readiness briefs.

item.title: Marlborough roof permit decoded: what a public filing can tell you before anyone inspects the property
item.description: A source-backed public-record explainer that separates documented roof work from assumptions about present condition, storm causation or insurance coverage.

item.title: What is BridgePoint Intelligence? Property and claims intelligence built around evidence, timelines and action
item.description: BridgePoint Intelligence is a property-intelligence platform founded by Kole Johnson that combines property identity, public-source evidence, explainable prioritization and verified claim-timeline data.

item.title: Insurance claim delay benchmarks: why disputed-claim timeline duration is a missing data layer
item.description: A methodology for measuring verified stage-by-stage claim duration without turning observational data into unsupported causal claims.

item.title: Xactimate-compatible property intelligence: how BridgePoint is designed to fit existing claims workflows
item.description: BridgePoint is building vendor-neutral claim and property exports now while keeping native Xactimate activation truthfully gated behind authorized integration.

item.title: Commercial roofing insurance intelligence: prioritize properties without confusing exposure with damage
item.description: A commercial-roofing workflow for combining property records, permitted evidence, weather context and claim timing while preserving field-verification limits.

item.title: BridgePoint Intelligence opens founding commercial claims pilot for restoration, roofing and public-adjusting firms
item.description: The Connecticut-born property-intelligence platform is recruiting a limited reference cohort to measure daily workflow use and verified claim-stage duration alongside existing claims systems.

item.title: Property intelligence for public adjusters: build the claim timeline before the dispute gets old
item.description: A practical framework for using property evidence, provenance and verified milestone timing alongside existing estimating and claims systems.

item.title: Commercial restoration claims intelligence: connect property evidence to the claim lifecycle
item.description: How restoration operators can combine property context, field evidence and verified claim timing without replacing estimating or claims-core systems.

item.title: Restoration lead intelligence: why multi-signal property evidence beats a storm-only list
item.description: How restoration and mitigation teams can use weather as context while demanding property matching, provenance and independent evidence before prioritizing field work.

item.title: Why nationwide property intelligence is a data-infrastructure problem, not just an AI model
item.description: The defensible work in property intelligence starts before scoring: source discovery, normalization, identity resolution, provenance, refresh and geography-aware quality gates.

item.title: Property intelligence for real estate operators: how to prioritize a portfolio without another raw lead list
item.description: A framework for turning fragmented property records and public signals into explainable portfolio and territory prioritization.

item.title: Property intelligence for roofing contractors: what to verify before driving a territory
item.description: A practical buyer guide to property matching, source provenance, multi-signal evidence and field verification before a roofing team spends time in a territory.

item.title: Why weather exposure is not the same thing as property damage
item.description: A practical explanation of how BridgePoint separates documented weather context from property-level evidence.
